SELECT 
    i_item_id, 
    ca.ca_country, 
    ca.ca_state, 
    ca.ca_county, 
    AVG(CAST(cs.cs_quantity AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg1, 
    AVG(CAST(cs.cs_list_price AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg2, 
    AVG(CAST(cs.cs_coupon_amt AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg3, 
    AVG(CAST(cs.cs_sales_price AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg4, 
    AVG(CAST(cs.cs_net_profit AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg5, 
    AVG(CAST(c.c_birth_year AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg6, 
    AVG(CAST(cd1.cd_dep_count AS DECIMAL(12, 2))) AS agg7 
FROM 
    catalog_sales AS cs 
JOIN 
    date_dim AS d 
    ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk 
    AND d.d_year = 2001 
JOIN 
    customer_demographics AS cd1 
    ON cs.cs_bill_cdemo_sk = cd1.cd_demo_sk 
    AND cd1.cd_gender = 'F' 
    AND cd1.cd_education_status = 'Primary' 
JOIN 
    customer AS c 
    ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk 
    AND c.c_birth_month IN (1, 3, 7, 11, 10, 4) 
JOIN 
    customer_address AS ca 
    ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk 
    AND ca.ca_state IN ('AL', 'MO', 'TN', 'GA', 'MT', 'IN', 'CA') 
JOIN 
    customer_demographics AS cd2 
    ON c.c_current_cdemo_sk = cd2.cd_demo_sk 
JOIN 
    item AS i 
    ON cs.cs_item_sk = i.i_item_sk 
GROUP BY 
    ROLLUP (i_item_id, ca.ca_country, ca.ca_state, ca.ca_county) 
ORDER BY 
    ca.ca_country, 
    ca.ca_state, 
    ca.ca_county, 
    i_item_id 
LIMIT 100
